name: ✦ SKY X NETWORK (V6) ✦
description:
SkyXNetwork is a Minecraft server with Survival, Mining Tycoon and Skygen. Survival is the main mode, so if you just got here, that’s the one to try first.

Survival is a heavily customized modded survival. The world border is 10k x 10k, and the End and Nether reset every month. You get quests, jobs, shops, crates, an auction house, warps, homes, RTP and mineable spawners. There are also custom armor, weapons and items, ranks with perks, PvP duels and arenas, and events and giveaways.

There’s an economy where you can buy and sell with other players, a store, and a Discord that’s active every day. Staff are online a lot and usually reply quickly if you need help.

Bedrock is supported!

Java IP: skyxnetwork.net

Bedrock IP: skyxnetwork.net (port 19132)

Versions: 1.20.2 to 26.4
